moon.blurb_en: Its phases have marked months for people for thousands of years.
moon.blurb_ar: منازله تعدّ الشهور للناس منذ آلاف السنين.
moon.visual_hints: A full, gibbous or crescent moon in a night or twilight sky; a pale disc or crescent, often with grey surface markings; printed or on-screen photos of the moon count. Not: street lamps, round ceiling lights, the sun, a white plate.

sun.blurb_en: A daily sign that rises and sets over everyone alike.
sun.blurb_ar: آية يومية تشرق وتغرب على الناس جميعًا.
sun.visual_hints: The sun in the sky, a sunrise or sunset with the sun's disc visible, or bright sunlight with a visible sun flare. Not: a lamp or bulb, the moon, a sun-shaped logo.

stars.blurb_en: For travellers, the night sky was once the map.
stars.visual_hints: A night sky with many points of light, star fields, the Milky Way, or a planetarium or printed star image. Not: fairy lights, a star-shaped decoration, a single street light.

night_day.blurb_en: Sunset and sunrise: the rhythm that shapes every day.
night_day.blurb_ar: الغروب والشروق: إيقاع يصوغ كل يوم.
night_day.visual_hints: A sunset or sunrise scene, the sky changing from day to night (dusk, twilight, golden hour), a horizon with the sun low. Not: a lamp-lit room, a photo of only the sun's disc.

clouds.blurb_en: Look up: clouds carry the rain that revives the land.
clouds.blurb_ar: انظر إلى الأعلى: السحاب يحمل المطر الذي يحيي الأرض.
clouds.visual_hints: Clouds filling much of the frame: cumulus, rain clouds, overcast sky, clouds seen through a window. Not: smoke, steam, cotton wool, fog at ground level.

rain_water.blurb_en: A glass of water starts with rain from the sky.
rain_water.blurb_ar: كوب الماء يبدأ بمطر ينزل من السماء.
rain_water.visual_hints: Rain falling, raindrops on a window, puddles, or drinking water: a glass, cup or bottle of clear water. Not: other drinks (juice, milk, tea), the sea, a river.

water_life.blurb_en: Water and the living things that depend on it.
water_life.blurb_ar: الماء وما يقوم عليه من حياة.
water_life.visual_hints: Disabled: overlaps with rain & water; its usual verse (21:30) is often framed as a scientific proof, which this app avoids.

lightning.blurb_en: A flash in a stormy sky, and the sound that follows.
lightning.blurb_ar: ومضة في سماء عاصفة، وصوت يتبعها.
lightning.visual_hints: Disabled for camera use: lightning is rarely photographed live. A printed photo would show bright jagged bolts in a dark, stormy sky.

wind.blurb_en: Unseen, yet it moves clouds, ships and trees.
wind.blurb_ar: لا تُرى، لكنها تسوق السحاب والسفن وتحرّك الشجر.
wind.visual_hints: Disabled: wind is invisible to a camera; flags, bending trees or turbines are ambiguous. One commonly cited verse (15:22) is often framed as a scientific proof.

shadow.blurb_en: Watch a shadow stretch and shrink as the day moves.
shadow.blurb_ar: تأمّل الظل وهو يمتد وينقبض مع مسير النهار.
shadow.visual_hints: A clear cast shadow of an object or person on a floor, wall or table, e.g. from a desk lamp or sunlight; a sundial. Not: a dark photo with no clear light source, silhouettes against a bright sky.

mountain.blurb_en: Firm, high and still: an invitation to look closely.
mountain.blurb_ar: راسخة شامخة ساكنة: دعوة إلى النظر والتأمل.
mountain.visual_hints: Mountains or rocky peaks in a landscape photo or print; a mountain range on the horizon. Not: a small rock or pebble, sand dunes, buildings.

sea.blurb_en: Food, pearls and ships: the sea as a gift to people.
sea.blurb_ar: طعام وحلية وسفن: البحر نعمة مسخّرة للناس.
sea.visual_hints: Open sea or ocean, waves, a coastline, a boat on the water, a seascape print. Not: a swimming pool, a glass of water, a river or lake with near banks on both sides.

river.blurb_en: Running water that carries life through the land.
river.blurb_ar: ماء جارٍ يحمل الحياة في الأرض.
river.visual_hints: A river or stream flowing between banks, a waterfall feeding a river. Not: the sea, a still lake, a canal in a city with no visible flow.

stone.blurb_en: Rock and stone in the world around you.
stone.visual_hints: Disabled: a pebble is hard to tell apart from many objects, and the best-known verse (2:74) is a rebuke that needs careful context for a first encounter.

soil.blurb_en: The earth that plants grow from.
soil.visual_hints: Disabled: soil photographs poorly, and related verses are often pulled into embryology claims that this app avoids.

iron.blurb_en: The strong metal used in tools and buildings.
iron.visual_hints: Disabled: metal objects are hard to identify as iron, and the usual verse (57:25) is widely framed as a scientific proof, which this app avoids.

ships.blurb_en: Vessels that sail the sea and carry people and goods.
ships.blurb_ar: سفن تجري في البحر تحمل الناس والمتاع.
ships.visual_hints: A ship, sailing boat, dhow or fishing boat, on water or in a picture; a toy or model boat. Not: a car, a plane, a bathtub.

salt_fresh.blurb_en: Two kinds of water, side by side.
salt_fresh.visual_hints: Disabled: salt and fresh water look identical to a camera, and the related verses (25:53) are commonly framed as an oceanography proof.

pearl_coral.blurb_en: Treasures brought up from the sea.
pearl_coral.visual_hints: Pearls (necklace, single pearls, oyster with pearl) or red/pink coral, real or in jewellery. Not: white beads that are clearly plastic, shells without pearls.

date_palm.blurb_en: The tree at the heart of Arabian life, and its sweet fruit.
date_palm.blurb_ar: شجرة حاضرة في حياة الجزيرة العربية، وثمرها الحلو.
date_palm.visual_hints: A date palm tree (tall trunk, crown of long feathery fronds), clusters of dates on the tree, or dates in a box or bowl (brown, oval, glossy). Not: raisins, prunes, chocolate; other palms without dates are a weak match.

olive.blurb_en: A blessed tree, its fruit and its golden oil.
olive.visual_hints: Olives (green or black, in a bowl or jar), an olive branch or tree with silvery leaves, or a bottle of olive oil. Not: grapes, capers, other cooking oils without olive labelling.

fig.blurb_en: A fruit named in the oath that opens a chapter of the Quran.
fig.blurb_ar: ثمرة ذُكرت في القسم الذي تبدأ به إحدى سور القرآن.
fig.visual_hints: Fresh figs (purple or green, teardrop-shaped, pink inside when cut) or dried figs. Not: onions, plums, dates.

pomegranate.blurb_en: A crown-topped fruit full of ruby seeds.
pomegranate.visual_hints: A whole pomegranate (red, round, with a small crown) or one cut open showing red seeds. Not: apples, tomatoes, red onions.

grapes.blurb_en: Clusters on the vine, among the fruits the Quran names.
grapes.blurb_ar: عناقيد على الكرمة، من الثمار التي يسمّيها القرآن.
grapes.visual_hints: Bunches of grapes (green, red or black) or a grapevine with clusters. Not: olives, berries, cherry tomatoes.

tree_leaf.blurb_en: Not a single leaf falls unnoticed.
tree_leaf.blurb_ar: لا تسقط ورقة إلا في علم الله.
tree_leaf.visual_hints: A tree, a potted plant with visible leaves, a branch, or a single leaf (green or autumn). Not: a date palm specifically (prefer date palm), artificial flowers, a printed leaf logo.

grain.blurb_en: One seed, seven ears: a picture of generosity.
grain.blurb_ar: حبة واحدة وسبع سنابل: صورة للعطاء.
grain.visual_hints: Ears of wheat or barley, a field of grain, a handful of seeds or grains (wheat, barley, rice). Not: bread alone, sand, sugar.

milk.blurb_en: A pure drink, and a lesson in the grazing animals.
milk.visual_hints: A glass, cup, bottle or carton of milk; white liquid clearly labelled or presented as milk. Not: water, yoghurt pots without milk, white paint.

honey_bee.blurb_en: A chapter of the Quran is named after the bee.
honey_bee.blurb_ar: في القرآن سورة تحمل اسم النحل.
honey_bee.visual_hints: A honey jar or honey dripping from a spoon or comb; honeycomb; a bee on a flower or a beehive. Not: syrup or oil with no honey label, wasps, flies.

onion_garlic.blurb_en: Everyday foods named in a story of the Children of Israel.
onion_garlic.blurb_ar: أطعمة يومية ذُكرت في قصة بني إسرائيل.
onion_garlic.visual_hints: Disabled: the only verse (2:61) needs heavy context about the story of the Children of Israel and reads poorly as a first encounter.

ant.blurb_en: A tiny creature with a whole chapter named after it.
ant.blurb_ar: مخلوق صغير سُمّيت باسمه سورة كاملة.
ant.visual_hints: Ants (close-up photo or print), an ant trail or anthill. Not: spiders, beetles, specks of dirt.

spider.visual_hints: Disabled: its verse (29:41) is a parable about false protectors, which needs context and reads as a rebuke in a first encounter.

birds.blurb_en: Wings spread and folded: who holds them up?
birds.blurb_ar: أجنحة تبسط وتقبض: من يمسكها في الجو؟
birds.visual_hints: One or more birds, flying or perched: pigeons, sparrows, falcons, flocks in the sky, a printed bird photo. Not: planes, kites, insects, feathers alone.

camel.blurb_en: An invitation to look closely at the camel, and how it was made.
camel.blurb_ar: دعوة قرآنية إلى النظر في الإبل وكيف خُلقت.
camel.visual_hints: A camel (one or two humps, long neck, long legs), real, in a print, or as a toy or figurine. Not: horses, llamas, sand dunes without a camel.

livestock.blurb_en: Sheep, cattle and goats: food, wool and companions of daily life.
livestock.blurb_ar: الغنم والبقر والمعز: طعام وصوف ورفقة في الحياة اليومية.
livestock.visual_hints: Sheep, goats or cattle in a field or pen, or wool and leather goods shown with an animal. Not: camels (prefer camel), horses, pets such as cats and dogs.

horse.blurb_en: Strength and beauty, long honoured in Arabia.
horse.blurb_ar: قوة وجمال، ولها مكانة قديمة في الجزيرة العربية.
horse.visual_hints: A horse (real, print, statue or toy), possibly with a rider. Not: donkeys, camels, zebras.

fish.blurb_en: Remembered in the story of the prophet Yunus (Jonah).
fish.blurb_ar: حاضر في قصة النبي يونس عليه السلام.
fish.visual_hints: A fish or whale (live, in an aquarium, on a plate, or in a print). Not: dolphins shown as toys, seafood such as prawns.

pen.blurb_en: The first revealed words began with "Read".
pen.blurb_ar: أول ما نزل من الوحي بدأ بكلمة «اقرأ».
pen.visual_hints: A pen or pencil (ballpoint, fountain pen, marker), writing on paper, a hand holding a pen. Not: a calligrapher's reed pen with ink pot (prefer pen & ink), chopsticks, a stylus on a tablet.

lamp.blurb_en: A lamp that lights a room, and a verse about light.
lamp.blurb_ar: مصباح يضيء المكان، وآية عن النور.
lamp.visual_hints: A desk lamp, table lamp, lantern or oil lamp that is switched on. Not: a decorated glass mosque lamp (prefer mosque lamp), the sun, a phone torch.

qibla.blurb_en: One direction for prayer, wherever you are in the world.
qibla.blurb_ar: وجهة واحدة للصلاة حيثما كنت في العالم.
qibla.visual_hints: A qibla compass, a phone compass app pointing to Makkah, a prayer mat, a qibla sign or arrow in a hotel room or airport. Not: an ordinary map, a clock.

time_asr.blurb_en: A whole chapter begins with an oath by time.
time_asr.visual_hints: A wall clock, wristwatch, hourglass or a phone clock screen; late-afternoon light. Not: a compass, a calendar.

calligraphy_inscription.blurb_en: Point at an inscription and we will try to find its verse.
calligraphy_inscription.blurb_ar: وجّه الكاميرا إلى نقش وسنحاول أن نجد آيته.
calligraphy_inscription.visual_hints: Arabic script written as art: a calligraphy panel, a framed inscription, a frieze of letters on a building, tiles or textiles with Arabic writing, a page of elegant Arabic text. Not: printed modern signage or menus, Persian or Urdu shop signs, non-Arabic scripts.

pen_and_ink.blurb_en: The calligrapher's qalam, cut by hand from a reed.
pen_and_ink.blurb_ar: قلم الخطاط، يُبرى باليد من القصب.
pen_and_ink.visual_hints: A calligrapher's reed or bamboo pen (qalam) with a slanted nib, an inkwell or ink pot, a pen case, a calligrapher's desk. Not: an ordinary ballpoint (prefer pen), paintbrushes.

mihrab.blurb_en: The niche that shows which way to face in prayer.
mihrab.blurb_ar: التجويف الذي يدلّ على وجهة الصلاة.
mihrab.visual_hints: An arched niche set into the wall of a prayer hall, often richly decorated with tiles, marble or inscriptions, usually with a pulpit (minbar) beside it. Not: a doorway, a window, a fireplace, a church apse.

minaret_call_to_prayer.blurb_en: The tower, and the call to prayer it is known for.
minaret_call_to_prayer.blurb_ar: البرج، والنداء إلى الصلاة الذي يرتبط به.
minaret_call_to_prayer.visual_hints: A minaret: a tall, slender tower beside or on a mosque, often with balconies and a pointed or bulbous top. Not: church towers with crosses, clock towers, lighthouses, telecom masts.

mosque_dome.blurb_en: A place of prayer, and the domes that crown many mosques.
mosque_dome.blurb_ar: مكان للصلاة، وقباب تعلو كثيرًا من المساجد.
mosque_dome.visual_hints: A mosque building or interior prayer hall; a large dome on a mosque, often with minarets nearby; rows of carpets in a prayer hall. Not: churches, palaces or government buildings with domes, planetariums.

mosque_lamp.blurb_en: Glass lamps that often carry the Light Verse.
mosque_lamp.blurb_ar: قناديل زجاجية كثيرًا ما تحمل آية النور.
mosque_lamp.visual_hints: A glass hanging lamp with a wide flared neck and a rounded body, often enamelled or gilded with Arabic inscriptions and suspension loops; museum photos of Mamluk lamps. Not: modern chandeliers, ordinary light bulbs, lanterns without glass.

geometric_pattern.blurb_en: Stars and polygons drawn with only a compass and a ruler.
geometric_pattern.visual_hints: Interlacing star-and-polygon patterns (8-, 10- or 12-point stars) on tiles, woodwork, mashrabiya screens, plaster or metal; repeating tessellations. Not: checkerboards, modern logos, floral patterns (prefer arabesque).

arabesque.blurb_ar: سيقان وأوراق متصلة تمتد بلا نهاية.
arabesque.visual_hints: Curving, interlacing vegetal scrolls with stylised leaves and split palmettes on tiles, carved plaster, book covers, carpets or metalwork. Not: realistic flower paintings, geometric star patterns (prefer geometric patterns).

muqarnas.blurb_en: Honeycomb vaults that turn ceilings into light and shadow.
muqarnas.blurb_ar: عقود كخلايا النحل تجعل السقوف ضوءًا وظلًا.
muqarnas.visual_hints: Three-dimensional honeycomb or stalactite-like vaulting made of many small niches, under domes, in portals or on minaret balconies. Not: flat geometric tiles, natural caves, egg cartons.

illuminated_mushaf.blurb_en: Hand-written copies of the Quran, decorated in gold.
illuminated_mushaf.visual_hints: A page or open copy of a hand-written Quran with gold and coloured illumination: decorated chapter headings, gold verse markers, ornamented frontispieces; museum images of Quran folios. Not: a modern printed mushaf without illumination (prefer calligraphy for reading the text), non-Arabic illuminated books.

astrolabe.blurb_en: A brass model of the sky, used to tell time by the stars.
astrolabe.blurb_ar: نموذج نحاسي للسماء، يُعرف به الوقت من النجوم.
astrolabe.visual_hints: A round brass instrument with a ring for hanging, an engraved plate and an openwork star map (rete) on top, sometimes with a sighting rule on the back. Shown at category level only, never as a specific museum object. Not: clocks, compasses, coins, armillary spheres.

manuscript_page.blurb_en: A page transcribed and approved by an institution.
manuscript_page.visual_hints: Disabled for camera recognition: specific manuscript pages are opened by item code or QR from the heritage section, never guessed from a photo.

kiswa_textile.blurb_en: The black cloth that covers the Kaaba, embroidered in gold.
kiswa_textile.blurb_ar: الثوب الأسود الذي يكسو الكعبة، مطرّز بالذهب.
kiswa_textile.visual_hints: Black silk cloth with gold- or silver-embroidered Arabic inscriptions in a band, or a photo of the Kaaba draped in black. Not: other black fabrics, flags, tapestries without Arabic embroidery.
